name: acad-layers
description: AutoCAD layer (LayerTableRecord) management: create, rename, delete and list layers; query and set per-layer state (color by ACI or RGB, linetype, lineweight, plot style, plottable, frozen, locked, on/off, transparency); pick the current layer; bulk move entities between layers; and basic layer-state save / restore via AutoCAD's layer state manager. All write operations require the AcadMcp .NET plugin loaded inside an open AutoCAD session and run inside a single transaction with a document lock.

tools_summary.name: create_layer
tools_summary.description: Create a new layer. Accepts color (RGB or ACI), linetype name, lineweight in mm, plottable flag and description.

tools_summary.name: delete_layer
tools_summary.description: Delete a layer (only if no entities reference it). Layer 0 and Defpoints cannot be deleted.

tools_summary.name: get_layer
tools_summary.description: Get full descriptor of one layer by name.

tools_summary.name: list_layer_states
tools_summary.description: List every saved named layer state in the active drawing.

tools_summary.name: list_layers
tools_summary.description: List every layer in the active drawing with color, linetype, lineweight, plottable/frozen/locked/off flags, plus the current layer name.

tools_summary.name: purge_unused_layers
tools_summary.description: Purge every layer that has no entity references and is not protected (0 / Defpoints / current). Returns number of layers removed.

tools_summary.name: rename_layer
tools_summary.description: Rename a layer. Layer 0 cannot be renamed; new name must be a valid AutoCAD symbol name.

tools_summary.name: restore_layer_state
tools_summary.description: Restore a previously saved named layer state.

tools_summary.name: save_layer_state
tools_summary.description: Save the current visibility/lock/color/linetype state of every layer under a named layer state (LAS).

tools_summary.name: set_current_layer
tools_summary.description: Set the active ("current") layer; subsequent draw operations default to this layer.

tools_summary.name: set_layer_color
tools_summary.description: Set a layer's color (true RGB or ACI 1..255).

tools_summary.name: set_layer_linetype
tools_summary.description: Set a layer's linetype (must already be loaded; returns LayerNotFound if linetype is missing).

tools_summary.name: set_layer_lineweight
tools_summary.description: Set a layer's lineweight in millimeters; snaps to nearest standard AutoCAD value (e.g. 0.13, 0.18, 0.25, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0 mm).

tools_summary.name: set_layer_state
tools_summary.description: Toggle one or more layer state flags: frozen, locked, off, plottable. null = leave unchanged. Cannot freeze the current layer.
